//: Story Phase 15: the Bashfulness Branch's customers, added to the Grand Bank Ledger as they're served.

entries.title: Grand Duke Gasimir the Excessively Solvent
entries.depositor: Grand Duke of the Overflowing Vaults, Master of Thirty Thousand Grand Wind Crowns, Freeholder of the Upper Draught
entries.notes: (Night. Served by the branch teller. I was in bed.) ALL OF IT. Thirty thousand Grand Wind Crowns. The lantern swung for an hour.

entries.title: Grand Countess Flatulencia
entries.depositor: Grand Countess of the Seven Generations, Heiress to the Ancestral Breeze, Trustee of the Compounded Gust
entries.notes: (Night. Served by the branch teller. I was in bed.) Seven generations, compounded. The interest had interest.

entries.title: Baron Billowmere of the Upper Draughts
entries.depositor: Baron Billowmere, Lord of the Upper Draughts, Owner of Every Breeze North of the Gusting Hills
entries.telegraph: Every breeze north of the hills. All of them his.
entries.notes: (Night. Served by the branch teller. I was in bed.) Regional, at least. Heeled the ship three degrees. At two in the morning.

entries.title: The Dowager Puffenstein
entries.depositor: The Dowager Duchess Puffenstein, Richest Lady in the Whole of the Afterlife (Atmospherically)
entries.telegraph: The richest of the lot. Her deposit has its own deposit.
entries.notes: (Night. Served by the branch teller. I was in bed.) Please Notify Authorities. That was the SMALL one.

entries.title: Grand Lord Boomington
entries.depositor: Grand Lord Boomington of Boomington, Boom-Warden of the Booming Marches, Thrice-Booming Knight of the Order of the Boom, First Boomer of the Boomtown Assembly
entries.telegraph: The title takes longer than the deposit.
entries.notes: Booming. Walked into the wall. Twice. Composure: total.

entries.title: Grand Duchess Whistlewaft
entries.depositor: Grand Duchess Whistlewaft of the... of the Something
entries.notes: Whistled. Forgot her title. (So did I.)

entries.title: Sir Fumblebottom
entries.depositor: Sir Fumblebottom, Knight of the Inside-Out Sash
entries.telegraph: He's holding the form upside down. And the sash. And possibly himself.
entries.notes: Sash inside out. Form upside down. Nearly started Brogath off. Nearly.

entries.title: The Grand Wind Brothers
entries.depositor: Grand Wind Brothers Hubert and Herbert, Joint Holders of the Family Gust (Undivided)
entries.telegraph: Two of them. They do everything together. EVERYTHING.
entries.notes: Joint deposit. In time. In stereo.

entries.title: Grandmother Boom-Boom
entries.telegraph: A sweet little old lady. You've been here before.
entries.notes: DO NOT TRUST THE GRANDMOTHERS. (Second one.)

entries.title: Professor Rumblequill
entries.depositor: Professor Rumblequill, Chair of Theoretical Windage, Author of 'A Brief History of Gust'
entries.telegraph: He's going to explain it. While it's happening.
entries.notes: Lectured throughout. I learned nothing. I know too much.

entries.title: Lady Flapworthy
entries.depositor: Lady Flapworthy, President of the Society for Free Flutter
entries.telegraph: Free flutter. Three yards of it.
entries.notes: Four yards of free flutter. Brogath held on. (Mellow, thank goodness.)

entries.title: Admiral Thunderpants
entries.depositor: Admiral of the Fleet Thunderpants (Retired) (He Thinks)
entries.telegraph: He's forgotten why he came. He hasn't forgotten how.
entries.notes: Forgot why he came. Remembered in time. Unfortunately.

entries.title: Grand Emperor Farthelmew
entries.depositor: Grand Emperor Farthelmew the Ninth, Lord of All the Winds of All the Grand Empires, Holder of More Grand Wind Crowns Than There Are Grand Wind Crowns
entries.telegraph: Everything. He wants to deposit EVERYTHING.
entries.notes: EVERYTHING. Realised mid-deposit that none of it is real. MID-DEPOSIT.

entries.title: Grand Lady Whifflebottom the Financially Cornered
entries.depositor: Grand Lady Whifflebottom the Financially Cornered, Baroness of the Lesser Gusts, Warden of the Western Wind-Gate, Holder of the Eleven Ceremonial Spoons
entries.telegraph: The collateral activation ceremony. Both hands on her sash.
entries.notes: Sash-backed loan: 47 silver. Collateral DESTROYED. Loan CANCELLED. Fees: NONREFUNDABLE.
